en.title: [Aviation and Drone Project Group] 2026 Aviation & Drone Consortium Industry-Linked Field Education Program in Aviation and Defense
summary: Recruitment of participants for the 2026 Aviation & Defense Industry-Linked Field Education Program hosted by the Aviation and Drone Project Group (항공드론사업단)
Eligibility: Inha University enrolled students (재학생) interested in aviation and drones (10 students)

Visiting Institutions & Activities: Yonam Institute of Technology infrastructure tour and AI/DX experience, field trips to Korea Aerospace Industries (KAI), Hanwha Aerospace, and KARI Space Science Museum
Application Deadline & Method: Apply via the provided online link by October 28 (Wed) at 13:00
en.easyExplanation: This is an on-site educational program for Inha University enrolled students (재학생) interested in aviation and drones to visit key aerospace and defense industry sites. Participants will visit Yonam Institute of Technology, Korea Aerospace Industries, and Hanwha Aerospace between December 22 and 24, 2026. Interested students must apply through the online link by October 28 at 13:00.
en.target: Inha University enrolled students (재학생) interested in aviation and drones
en.eventInfo: A 3-day field education program visiting Yonam Institute of Technology, KAI, Hanwha Aerospace, and KARI Space Science Museum.

author: 박태훈
originalContent:
항공드론사업단에서는 2026 항공드론 컨소시엄 항공·방산 산업체 연계형 현장교육 프로그램을 진행하고자 합니다.
관심 있는 학생 분들에 많은 참여 바랍니다.
1. 대상 : 항공드론에 관심있는 인하대학교 재학생
2. 모집기간: 10월 28일(수) 13:00 까지
3. 모집 인원 : 10명
4. 방문기관 : 연암공대, (주)한국항공우주산업, 한화 에어로스페이스, 한국항공우주연구원 우주과학관
5. 주요 일정
- 연암공대 인프라 투어 및 AI/DX체험
- (주)한국항공우주산업, 한화에어로스페이스 견학
- 한국 항공우주연구원 우주과학관 견학
6. 행사 일자 : 2026.12.22(화) ~ 2026.12.24(목)
7. 지원 방법 : 링크 를 통한 신청
8. 문의 : 항공드론사업단(thpark@inha.ac.kr), (T.032-720-9033)
